components.doc: luminance -> two colours: shadow -> dark, highlight -> light; contrast about pivot. Swap the colours for white line art on an accent field.
1-bit two-colour threshold; dither none | bayer4 | bayer8 (ordered), cell = dither cell in px at 1080p, spread = dither amplitude (1 = classic ordered dither).

lines = longitudinal lines per wall, depth = rings in view, drift = rings per second towards the camera (0 = still), zoom = focal growth per second, vp = vanishing point (fractions), width = line px @1080, fade = fog at the vanishing point

spacing / radius px @1080; drift px/s @1080; fade = dots fade toward the edges (0..1); hole = clear radius around glowAt (fraction of H) for type; glow = radial gradient strength behind the dots (glowColor defaults to color, glowRadius fraction of the frame diagonal)

palette peach | lilac | sky | dusk | mint | ink (or colors: [3-8 hex] + bg); base flat | vertical (sky); blobs = count; size = blob radius as a fraction of the frame diagonal; travel = path amplitude (fraction of H); speed = Hz of the slowest path; loop = seconds for an exact repeat (0 = free); grain = noise amount (0 = off), re-seeded grainFps times per second

colors = 2-5 hex (default violet, blue, pink: placeholders), bg = the black field (null = transparent); riseAt / rise = when the ribbon starts to rise from below the frame and how long (s), lead = how long before riseAt the pivot sound lands (cuesR6); height = rest height of the centre line (fraction of H), crest / waves = the drift amplitude (fraction of H) and its number of sine terms; spread = sigma of the wide glow (fraction of H), core = strength of the bright core, halo = the glow along the bottom edge; speed = Hz of the slowest drift; kick / kickDur = the brightness flash at riseAt; loop = seconds for an exact repeat (0 = free; a loop is already risen); grain / grainFps = seeded specks (0 = off) re-seeded grainFps times a second; res = columns of the frame (8-1024); intensity; seed

preset = 'clouds' | 'dunes'; sky = 2-3 hex (top to horizon); cover = 0..1 cloud cover (-1 = the preset's: 0.55 clouds, 0.16 dunes); scale = cloud size (1 = three cells across the height); drift = px per second at 1080 (negative = the other way); softness / haze 0..1; octaves 1-5 (the finest is dropped when it would alias at `cells` samples); cells = samples on the long side (24-256); sun = [x, y] frame fractions (null = the preset's, false = none), sunGlow, sunSize; cloud / shade = the lit and the shaded colour; dunes: sand = [lit, mid, shade], ridges 1-6, height (fraction of the frame the dunes fill), relief (crest amplitude, fraction of H), wind (px per second at 1080, the near ridges move more); loop = seconds for an exact repeat (0 = free-running); seed; intensity

stops = gradient-map colours from shadow to highlight (2 = duotone); the map resolves to natural colour from at over dur (reverse: natural -> map); ease lin | soft | hero | sine | expoOut; amount = map weight at full; contrast about pivot

n dots in `field` (fractions x, y, w, h) converge from at (+ seeded delay up to stagger s) over dur: to fewer (count dots on a centred grid, gap px @1080, merged dots grow by sqrt of how many landed), line ([x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions, count points) or word (text, size = cap height fraction of H, center); radius px @1080; drift = wobble px; toColor tints arrivals

from = source point (fractions); rect = window [x, y, w, h] fractions; mode window | globe (wireframe globe inscribed in rect); at / on = power-on start and length (s); rings = shimmer rings along the beam, speed = rings per second; scan = scanlines per frame height inside the window; flicker 0..1 per frame (hashed); fill = window tint alpha; radius px @1080; spin = globe turns per second

n dots + thumbs (<= 48) media tiles in `clusters` seeded gaussian clusters (spread), radius = cloud radius (fraction of H), spin turns/s (or loop: L s per exact turn), tilt rad, fov camera distance in radii; query chip text flies in at queryAt, the k nearest neighbours (precomputed) lift by `lift` toward the camera with lines; collapseAt: every point lands on the outline of `mark` (an SVG path d in a 100 box, e.g. your icon or logo; null = the pack placeholder mark; markSize = its height as a fraction of H); images: optional thumbnail sources (URLs / data URLs, or decoded images; each point always shows the same one). Await stack.ready() before the first frame, like fonts: until a source is decoded its tile is a placeholder, after that every frame draws the image

params.source: mean distance of the drawn curve from the input path

components.doc: path = an SVG d string, a preset (wave, arc, swoop, loop, spiral, bird) or [[x, y], ...] in pathBox px; closed auto (default: closed when the path ends in z or returns to its start) | true = a closed outline | false = an open path traced there and back (a Fourier series is periodic); samples = DFT size, even (resampled by arc length; sharp corners round off by under 1 px at 1024); terms N (or steps [[t, N | "full"], ...]: each step re-traces at higher fidelity); period = s per trace; loop (single step: exact repeat every period); trail = fraction of the figure kept behind the tip (1 = all); circles / arms / inset [x, y, w, h] fractions + insetZoom; readout prints N, the mean distance of the drawn curve from the INPUT path (every segment of it, not only the samples; N = full is under 0.05%, not exactly 0) and the `source` note under it, always (an empty `source` falls back to the default note; readout: false hides the numbers), type from the shorter frame side, at readoutAt [x, y] (move it up inside a 9:16 safe zone)

radius = hex circumradius px @1080, gap px; faces = sequence of tile faces (color | engrave | image) a wave flips each tile to the next; waves [{ at, from: [x, y] fractions, speed px/s @1080 }]; flip = s per tile flip; loop L: one wave every L / faces from loopFrom, exact repeat (the panel bob then makes a whole number of 4 s swings per loop, so the seam holds with a panel too); images: sources for image faces (clip-path); panel { rect: [x, y, w, h] fractions, color, radius } floats above. Image faces are preloaded like embeddingCloud images (await stack.ready()); the lattice is offset rows of pointy-top hexes (the same geometry as axial coordinates)

nodes seeded in a field (radius fraction of H, wider in 16:9) around center; links = nearest-neighbour edges per node (plus hub edges); hub / dot = start and end radius of the solid dot px @1080; at / dur / stagger (radius-dependent delay; order outside-in | inside-out); reverse blooms the network out of the dot; bg = paper colour or null (transparent)
organic film burn for a transition: fbm field burning from an edge or a point, white-hot front, coverage peaks ON `at` (the cut) then retracts
anamorphic flare: horizontal streak + hot line + core glow through a moving source, 3 mirrored ghost ovals; `path` keys or a sweep
the genre finish on a DOM picture wrapper: grade + halation (+ ink) SVG filters, gate weave and exposure flicker per film frame; works on real <video> footage
